name: Sausage Balls
description: Crispy sausage and cheddar balls perfect for snacking or parties, made with biscuit mix and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the sausage in a frying pan until fully cooked.
Add the cheddar soup to the browned sausage and stir until well mixed.
Combine the sausage mixture with the biscuit mix and blend until a dough forms.
Form the dough into small balls (about 50 total).
Place the sausage balls on a cookie sheet and bake in a preheated 450°F oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

keywords: sausage balls, cheddar soup, biscuit mix, party snack

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Britt's Favourite Meatballs
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe with a sweet and tangy sauce, baked in the oven.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup quick cook oats or bran

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the first 8 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.
Shape the mixture into 1 inch balls and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink.
Combine sauce ingredients and pour over the meatballs.

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked
